series.visual_description: Top panel, dark gray solid line; gently dips near the left-middle, rises slightly to a broad maximum, then declines sharply toward the right edge.
series.axis_selection_reason: This line is identified by the top-panel legend as Input power and is plotted against the POWER [hp] axis on the left of the top panel. No calibrated horizontal axis is provided for the top panel.

series.visual_description: Top panel, light gray solid line; starts near 20 hp, dips modestly, rises to a shallow maximum, then falls toward the right edge.
series.axis_selection_reason: This line is identified by the top-panel legend as Shaft power and uses the top-panel POWER [hp] axis. No calibrated horizontal axis is provided for the top panel.

series.visual_description: Bottom panel, blue solid line; decreases almost linearly from about 30 m at zero flow to about 5 m at the high-flow end.
series.axis_selection_reason: The legend identifies this as Head; it corresponds to the left-side HEAD [m] scale and the bottom FLOW [l/s] axis.

series.visual_description: Bottom panel, green solid arch-shaped curve; rises from zero, peaks near the middle of the flow range, then declines at high flow.
series.axis_selection_reason: The legend identifies this as Hydraulic efficiency; its plotted magnitude aligns with the outer right-side EFF [%] scale, alongside the bottom FLOW [l/s] axis.

series.visual_description: Bottom panel, orange solid arch-shaped curve; rises from zero to a lower peak than hydraulic efficiency and then declines toward the right.
series.axis_selection_reason: The legend identifies this as Overall efficiency; it uses the outer right-side EFF [%] scale and the bottom FLOW [l/s] axis.

series.visual_description: Bottom panel, purple solid curve; starts at a moderate value, declines to a shallow minimum around the middle, then rises toward the right.
series.axis_selection_reason: The legend identifies this as NPSHR; its values align with the inner right-side NPSHR [m] scale from 0 to 15, using the bottom FLOW [l/s] axis.

warnings: The top panel has no calibrated horizontal axis among the provided axis IDs, so its x_axis_id is null.
